// REQ: LANG-1501 LANG-1502 LANG-1503
/* Load and summarize */
use "auto.dta", clear
local vars price mpg weight
foreach v of local vars {
    summarize `v', detail
}
generate ratio = price / weight
replace ratio = 0 if missing(ratio)
regress price mpg weight
display "Mean ratio: " %9.2f r(mean)
global outdir "results"
save "$outdir/auto_clean.dta", replace
